title: One Point, One Benched Bowers: The Commish Survives Kai, Randy Makes a Trade, and HULK Rolls On
dek: Sonny escapes the Dawgs by a single point while Brock Bowers watches from Mekhi's bench, three teams sit at 3-0, and the league's most famous non-trader opens for business.
body: The game of the week came down to one point and one lineup decision. Sonny's The Horse is Hea beat Mekhi's Dawgs 122.7 to 121.7, and the decisive fact was on the Dawgs' bench: Brock Bowers scored 22.6 points, more than double his 11.15 projection, while Kai's starting lineup came up a single point short. Justin Jefferson didn't help, delivering 4.2 points on a 14.79 projection. Mekhi did nearly everything else right, including grabbing Tyler Shough off the wire for Jameson Williams and getting 23.8 points from him in his Dawgs debut, the kind of pickup that earns his waiver reputation. It still ends with an 0-3 record and the most painful one-point loss the eight-team era has produced.

On the other side, Jaxon Smith-Njigba did it again for the commissioner, posting 30.36 points against a 17.19 projection a week after his 38-point game. The Horse is Hea is 3-0, and its title odds more than doubled, from 10% to 21%, making Sonny the clear No. 2 in the model's eyes. He also stayed busy, swapping the Broncos D/ST for the Eagles D/ST, the same unit JMoney let go this week, and making a trade with Ramon: Chuba Hubbard to The Horse is Hea, Rashee Rice to No Banner only HULK. Doing business with the league's best team is either bold or reckless, and the commish gets to find out which.

Speaking of the best team, Ramon took care of Kaushal's Habibsters 134.46 to 100.74 as a 77% favorite. No Banner only HULK now has 444.2 points through three weeks, 72.6 more than anyone else, and is the only team in the league with 100% playoff odds. Matthew Stafford posted 20.9 from Brucie's bench this time, which is a detail for the box score and nothing more, since HULK won by 34. Remarkably, his title odds dipped from 54% to 52%, the kind of decline most managers would trade their whole roster for.

Habib got a strong game from Drake London, 23.9 points on a 12.52 projection, and not much else that mattered against that buzzsaw. The two-time champ is 0-3, though his 319 points are within striking distance of the teams just above him. He went to work on the wire again, adding the 49ers D/ST for the Buccaneers D/ST, grabbing Sam LaPorta for Wan'Dale Robinson, and picking up Deebo Samuel Sr. while dropping kicker Jake Bates. Those are the moves of a manager who still believes, and with 12% playoff odds, the math says he should.

Randy edged Zoe in the Bears-versus-Packers grudge match, The fumblers winning 91.64 to 86.64 as a 68% favorite. It was the rookie who had the week's best upside play: Bijan Robinson went for 34.3 on a 17.31 projection, nearly doubling it, and Ghostu-Spider SZN still fell five points short. Randy survived Jonathan Taylor's 8.2 on a 19.1 projection, and the bigger news is off the field: he actually made a trade, sending Javonte Williams to Alan for Stefon Diggs. Brace yourselves, the market is open. Despite the 3-0 start, his title odds slipped from 21% to 16%, likely because his 91.64 was the lowest winning score of the week. Zilgit, meanwhile, rebuilt on the fly, adding Josh Downs for Brian Thomas Jr., Blake Corum for Jonathon Brooks, and kicker Trey Smack for Cairo Santos.

Alan's Team Pillbert handled Jordan's Counting or not Counting GV 117.88 to 100.98 behind a two-man show: Jahmyr Gibbs posted 37.9, the week's top performance, and Brock Purdy added 31.28. Philly needed every bit of it, because De'Von Achane gave him 1.7 points on a 17.27 projection, the week's biggest bust, and Harold Fannin Jr. scored 20.6 on his bench. He kept churning too, adding Bryce Young, dropping Jaxson Dart, picking up Denzel Boston, and cutting the Lions D/ST. Somehow the win dropped his title odds from 13% to 9%, so even the bad guy can't fully charm the model. Credit to JMoney, though: 100.98 is his best score of the season by almost 19 points, and he added Tank Bigsby and the Patriots D/ST hoping to build on it.

The standings now have a three-team penthouse: No Banner only HULK, The Horse is Hea, and The fumblers, all 3-0. Team Pillbert sits fourth at 2-1 with 76% playoff odds, Ghostu-Spider SZN is 1-2, and Dawgs, Habibsters, and Counting or not Counting GV share 0-3. The basement is crowded, but it isn't hopeless: Kai's 320.8 points are more than Zoe's 299, and the Dawgs actually rose to 13% playoff odds. Jordan is the outlier at 259 points and 1% playoff odds.

Week 4's headliner is Team Pillbert against No Banner only HULK, and the league will have to decide which of those two it wants to lose less. Two of the 3-0 teams face basement opposition: Randy draws an 0-3 Kaushal, while Sonny gets Zoe, who just watched Bijan nearly drag her to an upset. And Dawgs versus Counting or not Counting GV is an 0-3 elimination game in all but name. Somebody is getting off the mat, and somebody is falling to 0-4.

social.author: Dawgs Bench Mob
social.text: Brock Bowers: 22.6 points. Final margin: 1 point. We're not mad. We're just going to stare at this lineup screen for the rest of the week.

social.author: Horse is Hea Fan Club
social.text: 3-0. Title odds 10% to 21%. JSN with another 30-burger. Survived by a single point because that's what champions do. Neigh-sayers, form a line.

social.author: BFL Trade Desk Insider
social.text: BREAKING: Randy has completed a trade. Javonte Williams out, Stefon Diggs in. Experts are checking whether the sun rose in the west this morning.

social.author: Ghostu-Spider Nation
social.text: Bijan doubles his projection, we lose by 5 to a Bears guy. Zilgit added Downs, Corum, and Smack before the dust settled. The web keeps spinning.

social.author: Waiver Wire Watch
social.text: Kai grabs Tyler Shough off the wire. Shough drops 23.8. The waiver game is undefeated. The lineup game, this week, was not.

social.author: Philly Phan Phorum
social.text: Gibbs 37.9, Purdy 31.28, Achane 1.7. Our guy won anyway and the model docked him 4 points of title odds. The villain origin story writes itself.

social.author: HULK Smash Society
social.text: 444.2 points through three weeks. Next up: Philly. Somebody tell the league which side to root for, because it's gonna be awkward.

social.author: Habibsters Faithful
social.text: 0-3 but Drake London showed up and LaPorta and Deebo are in the building. Two rings say don't bury the champ in September.

social.author: The Numbers Guy
social.text: JMoney posted a season-high 100.98. Still lost by 17. Playoff odds: 1%. The trendline is up, people. Small sample size, big heart.

bios.1: Sonny survived a one-point thriller to move to 3-0, and his title odds more than doubled to 21%. Jaxon Smith-Njigba has been a weekly cheat code, and Chuba Hubbard arrives via trade with HULK. The commish is now the model's top challenger.
bios.2: Randy is 3-0 after a gritty five-point win over Zoe, despite Jonathan Taylor's 8.2-point dud. He shocked the league by actually trading, landing Stefon Diggs for Javonte Williams. The model still trimmed his title odds to 16%, so he has something new to complain about.
bios.3: Jordan is 0-3 with a league-low 259 points, but his 100.98 this week was a season high. Tank Bigsby and the Patriots D/ST are the newest additions. Playoff odds are 1%, and next week's 0-3 matchup with the Dawgs is the best shot yet at a first win.
bios.4: Alan is 2-1 and riding a two-game streak after Jahmyr Gibbs and Brock Purdy combined for 69 points. Achane's 1.7 and a benched Fannin kept it closer than it should have been. Up next: a showdown with undefeated HULK.
bios.5: Mekhi is 0-3 after losing by a single point with Brock Bowers' 22.6 on his bench. The waiver pickup of Tyler Shough paid off immediately, and 320.8 points say this roster is better than its record. A must-win against Jordan awaits.
bios.6: Kaushal is 0-3 after running into the HULK buzzsaw, though Drake London gave him a big day. Sam LaPorta, Deebo Samuel Sr., and the 49ers D/ST arrive as reinforcements. The two-time champ has 12% playoff odds and a date with 3-0 Randy.
bios.7: Ramon is 3-0 with 444.2 points, the most in the league by a mile, and the only team with 100% playoff odds. He just added Rashee Rice in a deal with the commissioner, as if HULK needed more. Title odds of 52% say everyone else is chasing.
bios.8: Zoe is 1-2 after a five-point loss to Randy in which Bijan Robinson nearly carried her to an upset with 34.3. The rookie responded by remaking the roster with Josh Downs, Blake Corum, and Trey Smack. Playoff odds sit at 10%, with Sonny up next.
